items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: In Gilded Kisses, I, Stuff Smith and John Fielding--that was the trio.

ctx.x: Gilded Kisses, John Fielding and unknown--who is unknown?
The Trio. I changed it here. In Gilded Kisses, I, Stuff Smith and John Fielding--that was the trio. Stuff did this alone--
